title: Every candidate-link mint asks the send gate first, not the Outbox after
deviations_from_card: (1) Critic revision applied: a suppressed AI-interview arrival goes through failOpenToTheHumanQueue(entry, ws, 'suppressed', ...) and is PARKED on 'calendar' (card case 6 said setApproval is NOT called; the revision wins). (2) The card's 'handleStageEntered' is runStageEnteredHook in the tree. (3) The cascade is exported as resolveCandidateRecipient from comms-recipient.ts, including the agent refusal (null), so it equals comms-dispatch.candidateRecipient exactly; comms-dispatch.ts is untouched (r08 drawer/B owns it) - its own copy at :72 becoming a one-line delegation is the named follow-up. (4) The single invite route refuses only CODED (send-gate) refusals; an unaddressable person or an agent still gets a link for the copy panel (today's behaviour). The bulk planner maps an agent to SCHEDULE_BULK_UNADDRESSABLE (no new code). (5) Homework hook asks the gate twice: at the top of runHomeworkArrival (so a suppressed arrival does not run the case-design chain) and again before publishing. (6) Commit series is refactor/feat/feat/docs with tests inside each commit (each commit green) instead of a separate red test commit. (7) Write set grew by one coupled doc, docs/features/pipeline/README.md (feature-doc-map couples app/_lib/stage-hooks*.ts to it) - within the allowance.
